compute_optical_flow: compute optical flow between frame pairs using the RAFT model and save raw flow files
visualize_flow: visualize optical flow fields as color images with optional forward-backward warping
compute_flow_masks: compute consistency masks for flow pairs based on flow and color thresholds
warp_by_flow: warp a color image by a given optical flow field using geometry sampling
compute_flow_pair_stats: compute and export mask ratio statistics for frame pairs to a JSON file
